card.name: End of age group before dosing instruction
card.fires_on: The comma, colon, or last word of an age or product phrase in a directions section, right where an instruction verb or dose amount comes next (e.g. 'above 12 years of age' then 'spray').

modes.label: After age group
modes.description: The last word or punctuation of an age phrase such as 'of age' or 'years old' before the dose instruction.
modes.example: Adults & children above 12 years of<< age>>: spray 3 - 4 times

modes.label: Comma or colon before the instruction
modes.description: Punctuation closing a patient group or product name, just before the dose or action.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Miconazole Nitrate Vaginal Suppositories USP, 200 mg<<:>> One suppository (miconazole nit

card.writes: It pushes the model toward instruction verbs like apply, use, and configure.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a patient group has just been named and the directions for what to do are about to start.
